### Fixed
- **The agentgateway controller admits xDS from every data plane of its GatewayClass, in any namespace** (giantswarm/agent-platform#495): its ingress policy (both flavours) selected only the platform edge's data plane by Gateway name in the release namespace, so the serving slice's models Gateway in `org-<org>` connected to nothing — on gazelle its data plane was denied at 9978 (`Policy denied DROPPED`) and restarted by its startup probe forever. A second peer selects `gateway.networking.k8s.io/gateway-class-name` with the namespace label present, on 9978 only.
